epic.title: epic-567-door lane C: RAIL/refusal readability + advisory authority
epic.intent_and_why: Make the engine's RAIL banner and HARD refusal actionable to a cold agent (#442), and settle that the Stop hook outranks the context-trip advisory in shipped text, pointing the advisory at spine_halt block (#595).

definition_of_done: A cold agent shown only the rail and a HARD refusal can state what it is being asked to do and do it (#442), measured on real agents.
The Stop hook is stated as authoritative over the context-trip advisory in shipped text, and the sanctioned mid-run exit points at spine_halt block (#595).

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Text changes only inside the lane's sole-owned file (scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py) and shipped skill doctrine (crew-dispatch.md); no touch to fenced scripts/checklist_engine.py or scripts/mcp_spine_server.py; no change to when the Stop hook fires.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Independent implementer+reviewer crew verification against the working tree, plus fresh-process validation of the hook edit (in-session observation does not count, #269).

hard_constraints: Never edit scripts/checklist_engine.py or scripts/mcp_spine_server.py this wave (Lane A fence).
Never redesign the trip mechanic (change what it says, not when it fires).
File no issues; write triage candidates only.
Do not merge; open the PR and return.
fixed_decisions: decision:stop-hook-is-authoritative -- the Stop hook outranks the context-trip advisory.
decision:no-third-mechanism -- subordinate an existing mechanism in text, never add a new advisory surface.
decision:measure-on-real-agents -- #442 acceptance is measured on real cold agents, not author judgement.

current_wave.objective: Ship the in-latitude half of the mission (Stop-hook precedence text + crew-dispatch.md doctrine) and surface the fence-blocked half (#442's RAIL/HARD-refusal text, and the advisory's own wording) as a discrepancy for the Admiral to sequence.
exit_criteria: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py's Stop-hook refusal states Stop-hook-over-advisory precedence and names spine_halt block.
Fresh-process validation confirms the new wording renders from the edited worktree file.
The #442 fence block is recorded as wave evidence/discrepancy, not silently absorbed or silently dropped.

issues.title: State Stop-hook authority over the context-trip advisory; point the sanctioned mid-run exit at spine_halt block
issues.desired_outcome: A Commander caught between the Stop hook's refusal and the context-trip advisory has a stated, principled answer in shipped text (spine_rail.py's own refusal message and crew-dispatch.md), instead of inferring it from which mechanism happens to bite.
issues.useful_now: Two 2026-08-15 episodes (launcher-hygiene-002, stop-hook-door-binding-002) show real lanes hit this fork with no textual basis to resolve it; the cost is asymmetric (a wrongly-distrusted Stop hook can abandon a live run silently).
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Independent reviewer re-verification of the diff plus a fresh subprocess (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointed at this worktree) invoking the edited Stop hook against a synthetic mid-flight fixture, confirming the new wording renders.
issues.implementation_latitude: Wording of both edits; whether to also touch _owning_session_reason (decided: left unchanged, different scenario).

wave_forecast.outcome: Once Lane A's fence on scripts/checklist_engine.py lifts, a follow-up wave rewrites _RAIL_STRINGS (the RAIL banner + HARD refusal remedy string, #442) and _trip_advisory's SOFT-band wording (#595) to be actionable to a cold agent and to carry the same stated precedence, then re-measures on real cold agents.
wave_forecast.why_likely: The launch order itself names this exact collision as expected ('a genuine possibility for your mission; expect it and ask early rather than late'), and the pre-ruling decision:measure-on-real-agents already anticipates a real-agent measurement step once text exists to measure.
entry_conditions: Lane A's checklist_engine.py edits this wave are merged or the fence is explicitly lifted for this file.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether stating precedence in spine_rail.py + crew-dispatch.md alone (without touching the SOFT advisory's own wording in checklist_engine.py) is a sufficient 'settled in shipped text' deliverable for #595, or whether the Admiral wants the advisory's own wording changed too.
uncertainty_register.affects: Whether #595 is considered fully closed by this wave or needs a follow-up gate once the fence lifts.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: Admiral review of this lane's RETURN.md.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: Precedence is stated in both files this lane owns; the advisory's own text (checklist_engine.py) is unedited.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Admiral reads RETURN.md and either accepts the partial deliverable or schedules a follow-up wave.

parked_possibilities: A single source of truth for the precedence sentence instead of duplicating it across spine_rail.py and crew-dispatch.md (reviewer's triage candidate tc1).

completed_outcomes.outcome: scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py's _mid_flight_reason now states the Stop hook is authoritative over the context-trip advisory and names spine_halt block as the sanctioned mid-run exit; skills/commander/references/crew-dispatch.md states the same precedence next to its existing spine_halt block guidance.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Implementer/reviewer crew results at .agent-work/epic-567-door/cmdr-c/crew-handoffs/g1-{implementer,reviewer}-result.md; diff independently re-verified by the Commander; fresh-process subprocess (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set to this worktree) confirmed the new wording renders.

wave_evidence.claim: The RAIL banner text, the HARD refusal's remedy string, and the context-trip SOFT advisory's own wording are all authored in scripts/checklist_engine.py, not in this lane's sole-owned scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py.
wave_evidence.expected: The launch order's File Ownership section implied these strings were reachable ('wherever they are authored'), while its own Fence section separately warned this was 'a genuine possibility.'
wave_evidence.observed: grep-confirmed: _RAIL_STRINGS (RAIL banner text) at scripts/checklist_engine.py:310-326, the HARD refusal remedy string _refresh_attach_hint at line 1542-1543, and the SOFT advisory text at line 1858-1861 -- all in checklist_engine.py, fenced to Lane A this wave and marked FROZEN/verbatim ('do not paraphrase', a measurement precondition for #145). scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py contains only the Stop hook's own SPINE MID-FLIGHT text.
wave_evidence.source: Direct grep/read of scripts/checklist_engine.py and scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py at base commit 600de020, recorded in MISSION_FRAME.md and notes-c.md.

wave_evidence.claim: The Stop-hook-precedence text change renders correctly when the edited worktree file is executed, not merely when read in-session.
wave_evidence.expected: A fresh subprocess invoking the edited scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py against a synthetic mid-flight binding+spine fixture should print the new precedence sentence and the spine_halt block pointer.
wave_evidence.observed: It did: the Stop event's JSON reason field contained 'This Stop hook is authoritative over any SOFT-band context-trip advisory ... spine_halt block ... do not end your turn to "hand off."' exactly as edited.
wave_evidence.source: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<worktree> py scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py Stop < synthetic-stdin, run as a new OS process from this worktree; scratch fixtures deleted after.

discrepancies.signal: #442's two problem instances (the RAIL: banner text and the HARD refusal's attach-refresh-request remedy string) are both authored in scripts/checklist_engine.py, fenced to Lane A this wave -- this lane cannot deliver #442's acceptance criterion (a cold agent acting correctly on the actual banner/refusal text) at all, because it cannot legally edit the text the criterion is measured against.
discrepancies.affects: Whether #442 can be closed this wave, or must roll into a follow-up wave once the checklist_engine.py fence lifts.
discrepancies.evidence: grep/read of scripts/checklist_engine.py lines 294-326 (RAIL_STRINGS, marked FROZEN/verbatim, measurement precondition #145) and 1520-1545 (_refresh_attach_hint); cross-checked against LANE_A_LAUNCH_ORDER.md, whose own mission (#559 per-dispatch spine identity) does not plan to touch these specific strings either -- the fence is a wave-sequencing artifact, not a competing intent.
discrepancies.reason: This is evidence for the Admiral to sequence a follow-up wave, not a defect in this lane's execution -- the launch order itself flagged this exact collision as expected and instructed floating it rather than guessing past it.

discrepancies.signal: The context-trip SOFT advisory's own wording ('hand off here... advisory -- decline with a reason if you're nearly done') also lives in scripts/checklist_engine.py and was not edited by this lane, even though #595's suggested resolution point 2 names changing the advisory's own wording as one option.
discrepancies.affects: Whether #595 is fully closed or partially closed this wave.
discrepancies.reason: The pre-ruling decision:stop-hook-is-authoritative is satisfied by stating precedence in shipped text this lane DOES own (spine_rail.py + crew-dispatch.md); the advisory's own wording is a nice-to-have follow-up once the fence lifts, not a blocker to closing #595's core ask (a stated, actionable precedence).
